title: REVIEW & LAUNCH
briefing: Two years. One CubeSat. Let's make the plan fit.
I'll keep the bus, power and mass inside their limits.
I'll plan the passes so at least 70% of our data gets home.
I'll choose the imager and plan coverage of Sarawak.
2.5 million, ready in 24 months. Work alone, launch together.

nova: A reserve is a plan for surprises.
Let's check what the other departments need.
orion: Weigh it twice. Then write it down.
The battery has to carry the night.
juno: Healthy leaf, dry leaf. That is our question.
A clear target is worth waiting for.
kai: A beautiful image still has to get home.
Clouds above, rain at the dish. We plan for both.

dialogue: Now it all has to fit together. I'll take it from here.
Three conflict cards. We can change the plan. Nobody has to defend a mistake.

beats.objective: Aisyah: resolve the power and science conflict
dialogue: An instrument can be useful and still need more power than we have.
I'll compare the science gain with the eclipse load.

beats.objective: Aisyah: fix the mass and comms clash
dialogue: More radio capacity can consume our mass margin.
Fix the clash on paper before it becomes hardware.

beats.objective: Aisyah: fix the orbit and science clash
dialogue: The orbit we want and the orbit we can buy may differ.
Science asks for a second imager. I decide that here, in Mission Control.
Science, safety or cost. I place the token.
No wrong answer. Just a different mission.

beats.objective: Aisyah: submit the integrated plan for review
dialogue: We check the imager, Sarawak coverage and 70% data return.
Then two-year life, budget, mass and the 24-month schedule.
If a check is red, I name it. We can still launch. But a red check can cause trouble.
Time to work as one team. Hangar?
And Mission Control is go. Before launch: power, battery, antenna, instruments, mass, orbit, budget, schedule.
Amber means close to a limit. Any of us can step in to help fix an amber item.
The countdown begins. Reliability gives us odds, never a promise.
Whatever happens, we will learn from it together.
